page: Amazon Web Services r7gd.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System and powered by the 64-bit ARMv8 AWS Graviton3 processor using Neoverse-V1 cores. The configuration provides 48 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.6 GHz without simultaneous multithreading, eliminating core-sharing contention. It includes 384 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio, alongside 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network throughput of 22 Gbps. The system contains no discrete GPU hardware accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel compute and memory throughput. The instance achieves top-tier results in PassMark memory tests alongside strong ratings in multi-core compute metrics, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 252.97 GB/sec, while write bandwidth registers at 113.67 GB/sec. Conversely, single-core execution remains average across stress-ng and Geekbench tests, reflecting the architectural emphasis on core density and parallel bandwidth rather than high single-threaded clock frequencies.

In terms of cost efficiency, the r7gd.12xlarge leverages the Graviton3 architecture and integrated NVMe storage to deliver high throughput per resource unit. Combining dense memory capacity with fast local scratch storage reduces dependency on external block devices for temporary transactional data. The primary architectural tradeoff is its arm64 instruction set, which requires software stacks compiled for ARMv8 and lacks x86 extended vector instruction sets like AVX-512.

The hardware configuration is suited for in-memory databases, distributed caching nodes such as Redis, big data analytics engines, and transactional databases requiring high local storage IOPS. It also handles static web serving and parallel software compilation tasks efficiently.
description: Amazon Web Services r7gd.12xlarge is an ARM-based memory-optimized instance featuring 48 dedicated AWS Graviton3 Neoverse-V1 cores running at 2.6 GHz, 384 GB of memory, and 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor with 22 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and no discrete GPU, this instance provides an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. Synthetic and application benchmarks highlight strong multi-core scaling, top-tier memory bandwidth, and high throughput in database operations and Redis SET workloads, while single-threaded performance remains average. The server balances high memory density with integrated fast storage, reducing external storage overhead for cache-heavy architectures. With software optimized for the arm64 platform, r7gd.12xlarge is best suited for in-memory caching systems, distributed data analytics, transactional databases, and parallel software build pipelines.
